# data-sa-016

## Task Instructions
Estimate the Conditional Value at Risk (CVaR) at the 99% confidence level for GE stock. Calculate daily losses from historical data, determine the maximum weekly losses, fit a Generalized Extreme Value (GEV) distribution to these maxima, and compute the reserve needed to cover expected maximum weekly losses for a €1,000,000 GE stock holding in January 2010. Save the results in the required submission artifact following the provided format.
